annotations.title: Gift card and in-game currency prices

description: What gift cards, store credit, subscriptions and in-game currency cost at key shops: PlayStation Store, Xbox, Steam, Nintendo, PlayStation Plus, Game Pass, Apple, Google Play, V-Bucks, Robux, FC Points and more. Per size (up to 12, or the one matching amount): the face value or amount, the cheapest price in euros and its shop, the percent below the face value (negative when above), the number of offers and the size's page. The cards are for accounts in Germany, the EU and worldwide, unless country names one of the countries Keyfinder lists cards for (FR, BE, NL, ES, IT, AT, PT, IE, FI, GR, LU, GB, US, PL, CH, CZ, RO, HU, SK, BG, HR, CA, MX, BR, AU, NZ, AR, CL, CO, IN, SG, JP, KR, for store credit and console subscriptions). Use it when someone asks what a card costs or where it is cheapest. Prices are in euros, read within the last few hours, as the size's page shows them: where a shop's discount code lowers a price, price_eur counts it in and discount_code gives the code and the price without it. Read-only; Keyfinder records the call (tool, arguments and time).

amount.description: Optional size: 50 for a 50 euro or 50 dollar card, 1000 for 1,000 V-Bucks, 12 for 12 months.

brand.description: The card or currency, e.g. psn, xbox, steam, nintendo, v-bucks, robux, fc points.

country.description: Optional two-letter code of the account's country, e.g. US or GB. Default: Germany.

name: gift_card_prices

discount_code.description: A shop's discount code that price_eur already counts in, as the Keyfinder page names it. Name the code with the price: the buyer enters it at the shop's checkout.

needs_keyfinder_link.description: true when the code works only in a cart reached through the shop button on the Keyfinder page.

unit.description: A currency code, the brand's points, months, license or pack.
